reviews.text: Super convenient 2-in-1 brow product! The pencil draws hair-like strokes easily, and the brow gel sets them in place all day long without feeling stiff. Shade #01 Taupe Brown is very natural
reviews.zh: 超方便嘅二合一眉部產品！眉筆好容易畫出毛髮咁嘅線條，眉膠可以全日定住眉毛，又唔會覺得硬。色號 #01 Taupe Brown 好自然。

reviews.text: i’ve been trying to find an eyebrow pencil for a while that lightens my brows ever so slightly and this was perfect! the product lasts a long time and is very precise and a lovely shade
reviews.zh: 我一直想搵一支可以令眉色稍微淡少少嘅眉筆，呢支啱啱好！產品好耐用，控制得好精準，色調都好靚。

reviews.text: i sometimes pluck out my eyebrows due to a picking habit and this product is perfect for precise detail and making pretty good looking hair strokes to help my eyebrows look more normal!!
reviews.zh: 我有時會因為有拔眉毛嘅習慣而拔走眉毛，呢款產品好啱做精細嘅部分，畫出幾好睇嘅毛髮線條，幫我嘅眉毛睇落更加正常！！

reviews.text: The Flower Knows Sweetie Bear Dual-Ended Brow Gel & Pencil is simple but really good. The pencil is smooth and easy to use, not too hard and not too soft. It fills in gaps naturally. The brow gel holds the hairs in place without making them stiff. It’s perfect for quick, natural brows every day.
reviews.zh: Flower Knows Sweetie Bear 雙頭眉膠同眉筆簡單，但係好好用。眉筆質地順滑、易用，唔會太硬又唔會太軟。填補眉間空隙好自然。眉膠可以定住眉毛，又唔會令眉毛變硬。每日用嚟快速畫出自然眉型，好啱。

reviews.text: es una colección muy bonita, me ha gustado mucho la combinación del lápiz con el color de mis cejas naturales, el color es perfecto y también el acabado es muy natural, si, es poco producto, creo que es el único contra, pero todo bien
reviews.zh: 係一個好靚嘅系列，我好鍾意支眉筆同我原本眉毛嘅顏色配合，色號啱啱好，效果都好自然。係啦，產品份量少咗少少，我覺得呢個係唯一缺點，不過其他都好好。

reviews.text: Shade 02 matches beautifully with light to medium-brown brows, filling in sparse spots and shaping arches in the most natural way. The gel side tames and lifts hairs without turning them crunchy, giving my brows a soft but structured finish that lasts through the day. I love how the two sides work together — it’s like a little brow routine in one adorable tool! And yes, the packaging is too cute to resist 💖✨
reviews.zh: 02 色號好啱淺至中啡色嘅眉毛，填補稀疏位置，塑造眉形，效果好自然。膠嘅一邊可以撥順同托起眉毛，又唔會令眉毛變硬，令眉毛有柔和但有型嘅效果，全日都保持到。我好鍾意兩邊配合使用嘅感覺，好似一套小型眉部護理程序，集合喺一件好可愛嘅工具入面！係，個包裝可愛到令人抵擋唔住 💖✨

reviews.text: it’s ok in terms of like coverage it definitely changed the color of my brows, and the brow pencil is really natural too. the problem is it’s so little product thst i’m convinced it’d be gone in three uses, even if your brows aren’t thick. overall, i don’t know how i feel about it, i like it but i feel a little bit of regret. still, it’s a nice product, i can’t lie.
reviews.zh: 遮蓋方面都ok，佢確實令我眉毛嘅顏色改變咗，而眉筆部分都好自然。問題係產品份量好少，我好肯定就算你眉毛唔係好濃，都會用三次就冇晒。整體嚟講，我唔知點評價好，我係鍾意嘅，但係又有少少後悔。不過都係一款好產品，我唔抵賴。

reviews.text:
The dual-end eybrow pencil is great, not only the packaging is very beautiful, but also the quality is great, as expected from this brand!
I bought the 03 color which is a warm and light beige, perfect for blonde eylashes. The pencil is very creamy and the gel gives a little bit of colour to my eyebrows while making them stat in place.
reviews.zh: 雙頭眉筆好好，唔單止包裝好靚，質素都好好，一如呢個品牌嘅水準！我買咗 03 色，係暖調嘅淺米色，啱金色睫毛。眉筆質地好 creamy，膠會為眉毛帶少少顏色，同時令眉毛定型。
